notes: Pure-PyTorch ALIGNN (alignn_atomwise_pure model with pure_torch neighbor strategy; no DGL/torch_geometric). Graph-level property prediction, 4 ALIGNN + 4 GCN layers, hidden=512, cutoff=5.0 Angstrom, max_neighbors=12, three_body_cutoff=3.5 (force-field-compatible radius graph), atom_features=cgcnn, 300 epochs, AdamW + OneCycle, L1 loss. Same unified graph is used for property prediction and interatomic force fields.
